answer: The shortcut is `Ctrl-Shift-b` (`Cmd-Shift-b` on Mac). It runs `Baked Sections: Update`, which re-evaluates every baked section on the current page and rewrites each body with its latest output. This comes from `Baked Sections.md`.

  Using baked sections: - **Bake into page** — the ⋯ menu of block `${...}` widgets (tables, lists, diagrams) turns that live directive into a baked section in place. / - **The baked section’s ⋯ menu** (on its header): _Update_ re-evaluates just this section, _Edit expression_ puts the cursor in the opening marker, _Copy as Markdown_ copies the body, and _Unbake_ turns it back into a live `${...}` directive.
